commonAnnotations.summary: OTEL Collector scrape duration p99 exceeded 500ms for 5 minutes
commonAnnotations.description: The otel-collector scrape_duration_seconds p99 is 0.82s, breaching the 500ms SLO threshold. This may indicate the collector is under resource pressure or experiencing backpressure from upstream telemetry producers.
